description: Skills still in the old routing shape, keyed by their path under .skilled/skills. Each entry records the SMART ROUTING line and word counts, the machineBlocks count of MACHINE ROUTER sections left in SKILL.md, and the finding codes the skill was listed with. The check fails the skill if any count grows or a code appears that the entry does not record. Remove an entry when the skill moves to the routing canon; never raise one.
